pose.cutter: No cutter modeled; cutter must be removed. Spindle envelope retained in this check.

limits: Discrete 12 subdivisions per segment, actual CAD common volumes after AABB culling, plus conservative bounding solids enclosing each complete translation/rotation phase. No cable, hand-access, structural or thermal qualification.

water.note: Gross bound ignores all wall, comb, slat and fixture displacement, hence conservatively exceeds actual water volume. Nominal34L receiver is not a measured usable volume.

overflow_geometry.flow_qualification: Drop box intercepts front notch; back low opening feeds under-beam return; end deflector blocks forward jet and gives downward outlet. Gravity projection only: overflow throughput, wetting, splash, blockage and heating need cold-water/operating validation. No CFD claim.
overflow_geometry.receiver_temperature: Deploy as cold-service receiver only with tools isolated and pan cooled unless its shielding and liquid temperature are separately qualified. Primary pan coverage alone does not prove thermal safety.

cabinet.use: All four pads enclosed and lid mechanically secured before plasma mode. Open case only with tools isolated, water and steel cooled, cutter removed, and no work/fixtures on pads.
cabinet.qualification: Thin galvanized secondary spark/dust guard beyond nominal tool travel. Neither hermetic sealing nor thermal/fire protection is established by this geometry.
cabinet.receiver: Cold stationary open service receiver only, full bottom supported, no lifting filled, no pressure; usable volume must be measured at >=30L before draining.
